questions: Do you have a history of thyroid disease?
Have you noticed your eyes bulging out more recently?
Do you have pain in or behind your eyes?
Is the redness and swelling worse in one eye than the other?
orders: Measure intraocular pressure in both eyes
Assess for a relative afferent pupillary defect (swinging flashlight test)
Perform extraocular motility examination to assess for restriction or paresis
Order serum thyroid-stimulating hormone, free T4, and TSH receptor antibodies
Obtain MRI of the orbits with fat suppression
